title: THE YNi4B COMPOUND IN YTTRIUM-NICKEL-BORON SYSTEM
abstract: Abstract                A new-type compound, YNi4B, has been prepared by an arc-melting technique. The unit cell is hexagonal with a=4.977±0.004Å and c=6.942±0.005Å, probable space group P6/mmm, and contains two formula units. The structure consists of two units of YNi5 structure (CACu5-type), the nickel positions partly substituted for by boron atoms.
